coverage: Whole viewed once for layout, then a once and b once, followed by exactly one viewing of each of 13 unique tight enlarged crops. Read the complete printed letterhead and rule; all upper handwriting, interlinear words, four reference slots and their calls; all six cancelled loci; both item labels; every formula, index, arrow, prime and reference; the complete right marginal corollary and circled additions; En deduire/déduire; both dividers and right-end hooks; both pencil strips and underlines; all outer margins, the otherwise blank lower field, and bottom-left archive 23. No part remains unviewed. No other page or reader output was opened.

notes.text: The upper note is headed SGA 4 VII p. 20 and requests Ajouter 5.6. Part a adds properties of X tilde et, including the interlinear algébrique, d. torsion, and links the stated coherence or quasi-separation to the scheme X. Four (ref) slots and several cancellations are present. These are observations of the manuscript, not a proof check.
notes.basis: Top heading and complete part a, half a and crops 01–07.

notes.text: Part b names a filtered projective system with affine transition morphisms, writes X as the inverse limit, cites EGA IV 8, and displays a topos expression with literal baseline limtop and a left arrow below it. The instruction below is En deduire/déduire pour 5.7. No theorem has been checked mathematically in this run.
notes.basis: Part b, display and following instruction; half a and crops 08–11. Observation, not proof check.

notes.text: The marginal Cor. 5.6.1. has a visible X prime in Ob X_et, two cancelled predicates, a left circled abbreviation tentatively qu.-cpt, a live parenthetical abbreviation tentatively qu. sép, and a right circled resp. coh with an upward leader. The overwritten predicates prevent a fully settled literal corollary statement.
